name: claude-ask-modal
description: Shows Claude Code questions as a full-window modal with briefing screens, markdown, mermaid diagrams, clickable links, images, previews, a review step and a Dig deeper button, and returns the answers over a local MCP server.

claudeAskModal.port.description: Fallback localhost port (user setting) for Claude sessions with no per-project registration. Set it in workspace settings to pin this workspace's port instead of the one derived from its folder path.

commands.title: Claude Ask Modal: Show test question
